_comment: QR1 (USER 2026-10-29: 'Cycling should show in plans'): plan-item cycling on a deck whose provider does NOT
search its cycles (treasure_hunt keeps the generic dig loop in the autonomous search). Human play offers the hand
cycler as a plan action (HumanPlayCycleSources), so 'cast Treasure Hunt, cycle Lonely Sandbar' is ONE line, and its
payment holds the Island the cycle's {U} needs (PlanTraits::cycle_seed_pips): Treasure Hunt {1}{U} is paid Mountain +
Island, never Island + Island. Before QR1 the line was 'unsupported' (no enumerated plan cycles this way).
The graveyard pins prove the cycle happened (the human DigDraw pass skips an unpayable cycle without a
dropped-cast report). With MTG_ACT_LINE_HOLD=0 the payer spends both Islands on Treasure Hunt and the cycle fails.
